title: Coefficient intersection structural ring maps
statement: For morphisms f:X -> T, g:Tprime -> U, gprime:Xprime -> X and fprime:Xprime -> Tprime forming a cartesian square over f and g followed by the open inclusion U -> T, define k:Xprime -> Y=f inverse image U as the unique lift with k followed by Y -> X equal to gprime and k followed by Y -> U equal to fprime followed by g. For an open Z of Y, W=gprime inverse image of its image in X, and an open B of Tprime, the intersection I=W intersect fprime inverse image B lies in k inverse image Z. Define A -> D as restriction to Z after the displayed GammaSpecIso/canonical-chart composite A -> Gamma(Y,O), and define D -> S as k.appLE on Z and I. These are coefficientBaseRingMap and coefficientIntersectionRingMap.

proof.text: Use the universal property of the pullback restricting f to U to define k. Its first projection equation and preimage_image_eq show k inverse image Z = W. Then I is contained in k inverse image Z. Compose the ring maps on sections to obtain A -> D, and use appLE along this containment to obtain D -> S. All data are explicit constructions.

def coefficientIntersectionRingMap {X T T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens) (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens)
    (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W : X'.Opens) (hW : W = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z)) (B : T'.Opens) :
    Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, Z) →+* Γ(X', W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B)
